text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Friday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- The general prosecutor's office says that of seven MPs investigated so far for corruption only one, Indulis Berzins, has violated the law. He failed to declared his ownership of shares in a private company.
- Parliament is expected on August 28 to re-elect Einars Repshe as head of the Bank of Latvia.
- An Italian entrepreneur wants to buy the building occupied by Latvian state news agency LETA.
- The head of Latvia's grain bureau forecasts that the country's 1997 wheat harvest may reach 930,000 tonnes.
